entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about the VeloBand GPS Tracker I bought about a month ago. I'm having some second thoughts about it.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault, or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a preference thing. The device works, but the interface is quite confusing. To be honest, it's just really hard to use compared to what I'm used to.
I see. I'm sorry to hear it's not meeting your expectations. Many find that once they customize the home screen tiles, it becomes much more intuitive.

I tried that. I even read through the user manual a couple of times. I just expected more from the interface. Look, I know I'm past the 10 or 15-day mark most companies have. I'm not looking for a full refund necessarily, but maybe we could work out a partial store credit or a discount code for a future purchase?
I appreciate you explaining that. Let me just pull up our official return policy information to see what options we have. One moment please.
Okay, I've reviewed your account and our knowledge base. I see that you received the item 31 days ago, is that correct?
Yes, that's right. So, what can we do?
Well, you're in luck. According to my system, all VeloFit items are eligible for a return for a full refund within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 31, you are well within that window.
Oh, really? 90 days? I was prepared to negotiate for a small credit. That's fantastic news. So I can just send it back for a full refund?

Yes, absolutely. There's no need for partial credit. I can process a full return for you right now. I'll email you a prepaid shipping label, and once our warehouse receives the band, the refund will be issued to your original form of payment.
Wow. That was much easier than I expected. Thank you, Diana. I really appreciate your help with this.
You are very welcome. I'm glad I could resolve this for you quickly. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
